steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the tenant rule required for the revision approval scenario.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product for the vendor quote.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit and revise the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can quote.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid of 100.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Have the same vendor revise the bid downward to 90.
Return to the buyer session while keeping the vendor session separate.
Open the buyer comparison grid after the unapproved revision.
Verify the comparison still uses the original 100 before approval.

args.goal: approve Vendor A's pending bid decrease from 100 to 90 with a buyer remark, then return to the buyer comparison grid showing the approved revision

steps.note: Perform the buyer approval workflow and enter the required remark, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the approved revision is now the current comparison value.
